name: China Masters
stakes: This Super 750 event is a crucial opportunity for India's shuttlers to build on their recent World Championships success and for others to regain momentum on the path to major titles.
summary:
India's badminton contingent arrives at the China Masters Super 750 fresh off a historic BWF World Championships campaign, highlighted by Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand's stunning bronze medal in women's doubles. Their performance has injected a significant boost of confidence into the squad, marking a new high for Indian women's doubles on the global stage. This achievement underscores the growing depth of Indian badminton, particularly in the doubles categories.

While Treesa and Gayatri ride a wave of momentum, other key players will be looking to find their rhythm. Men's doubles pair Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, seeded fifth, will aim for a strong showing as they continue to manage fitness concerns. In singles, PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen—both top-ranked players—are keen to rebound after earlier exits at the World Championships, seeking to make a deep run in Shenzhen. The draw for the main rounds is yet to be announced, leaving the initial matchups for India's top talent TBD.
